# 8160 - 6-bit equality comparator, open-collector output

Package DIP-16 · family 8000 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/8160.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/8160.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 49 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![8160 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/8160.png) | ![8160 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-8160.png) | ![8160 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-8160.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | Y = STROBE OR ((A1 XNOR B1) AND (A2 XNOR B2) AND (A3 XNOR B3) AND (A4 XNOR B4) AND (A5 XNOR B5) AND (A6 XNOR B6)) | Y is high (output transistor off) when the two 6-bit words are equal, or when STROBE is high. Y is low when STROBE is low and the words differ. Open collector, so several can be wired together. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputMaxVoltageV | 5.5 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Open collector: IOH 100 uA max leakage at VOH 5.5 V. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A/B | Y | PLH | 15 | 25 |
| A/B | Y | PHL | 27 | 40 |
| STROBE | Y | PLH | 9 | 18 |
| STROBE | Y | PHL | 20 | 30 |

## Not known

- No minimum delays printed.
- The pin-7 label in the diagram carries a bar, but the description and truth table say a HIGH strobe forces Y high; the formula follows the truth table.

## Notes

National calls it a "magnitude comparator" but it only tests for equality.

## Sources

- [National Semiconductor 1976 TTL Databook, DM71/DM8130,60 Magnitude Comparators](https://www.bitsavers.org/components/national/_dataBooks/1976_National_TTL_Databook.pdf) - pdf 362-363 (printed 3-17, 3-18); DM8160

No sheet in this repository uses this chip yet.
